events.event: KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo says state losses in the PT Djarum excise-stamp (cukai) case are in the 'trillions of rupiah' range, a day after KPK searched Djarum's head office and the Kudus customs office.
events.key_numbers: Loss estimate: 'angka triliunan' (no exact figure) · new sprindik (investigation order) issued Oct 2026 · 0 suspects named · follow-up to Feb 2026 Bea Cukai case · period of alleged misconduct undisclosed, to be probed back several years
events.why_it_matters: A household-name cigarette maker is under KPK investigation over excise that feeds the state budget.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA hukum Terkini top; widely covered by CNN, Media Indonesia, Beritasatu, iNews

events.event: At the Jakarta Tipikor Court, prosecutors indict former Deputy Minister of Immigration and Corrections Silmy Karim and others of extorting immigration-service agents over residence-permit status changes; the indictment mentions a code 'RAMA' for a minister's share.
events.key_numbers: Total received Rp168.97 billion (2021-2026) · Silmy Karim Rp1.2 billion (also gratification Rp33.94 billion per Republika) · 'RAMA' (minister) Rp40 million per week · 'uang loket' up to Rp8 million per application · 7 defendants; presiding judge Atep Sopandi · Silmy files objection (perlawanan) to indictment
events.why_it_matters: Shows how foreigners' stay permits allegedly came with unofficial fees inside a ministry; the minister behind 'RAMA' is not named in the indictment coverage.

events.event: The Constitutional Court (MK) rejects a petition by four Palangkaraya residents affected by forest fires who challenged the word 'adequate' (yang memadai) in the Disaster Management Law on budget allocations.
events.key_numbers: Case 369/PUU-XXIV/2026 · UU 24/2007 Art 6(e) and 8(d) · MK read 20 judicial-review decisions the same day · ruling 'unfounded in law in its entirety' · read by Justice Liliek Prisbawono Adi
events.why_it_matters: Citizens could not force a measurable standard for how much government must budget for disaster response, as haze and fires remain a live issue.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA hukum feed top; MK 20-decision day listed in Terpopuler

events.event: Thousands of students and civil groups (BEM UI, SADAR) rally at Bundaran HI on Sumpah Pemuda to evaluate two years of the Prabowo-Gibran government; Jakarta police call the rally orderly and the road reopens, while Bakom says the government is open to input.
events.key_numbers: Organisers: 10,000-12,000 participants · 53 demonstrations secured by police in Jakarta that day · demands include economic-policy fixes, APBN cuts, declaring karhutla a national disaster · Yogyakarta rally reportedly turned chaotic (one outlet)
events.why_it_matters: Biggest student protest of the Prabowo term so far; government response and any follow-up rallies will shape the political mood.

events.event: Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra, after receiving the DEN study from Luhut, says the Tipikor revision will broaden the corruption definition but will not delete the 'state financial loss' element; the term 'perekonomian negara' is still undecided.
events.key_numbers: Meeting Tue 27 Oct at Dekonas · Pasal 2 and 3 described as 'pasal sapu jagat' · aim: single definition of state finances (BPK Law vs State Treasury Law differ) · no decision yet on removing 'economic loss'
events.why_it_matters: Decides whether officials can be prosecuted for policy decisions that lose state money.
events.spreading_evidence: detik most-commented: Sahroni on Tipikor revision (67 comments)

events.event: PKS Secretary-General Muhammad Kholid admits communicating with PDIP Secretary-General Hasto about following up the MK's findings on VP Gibran's diploma; PDIP separately says it 'doesn't like dealing with used goods' in reply to Gibran's volunteers.
events.key_numbers: Detik most-commented: PDIP vs Gibran volunteers 97 comments · PKS sounding out DPR factions (DPR in recess 9 Oct-9 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether a political route on the MK findings is forming across parties; MK itself found no evidence of an SMA-equivalent diploma but could not disqualify.

events.event: Former President Jokowi says he will attend as a prosecution witness at Roy Suryo and Dokter Tifa's slander/ITE trial at East Jakarta District Court next week.
events.key_numbers: Reported date 5 Nov 2026 · hearing at East Jakarta District Court · Roy Suryo: 'ini yang ditunggu-tunggu'
events.why_it_matters: A former president testifying in a case about his own diploma claims.

events.event: KPK examines Bogor Regent as a witness in a regency corruption case and probes assets received by Bengkulu city councillors and the husband of Pekalongan Regent Fadia Arafiq in a suspected money-laundering (TPPU) case.
events.key_numbers: Bupati Bogor witness exam (29 Oct) · Bengkulu DPRD assets probe · Fadia Arafiq's husband: TPPU
events.why_it_matters: Regional-head corruption cases keep rolling; Fadia Arafiq's case links to Jokowi circle coverage.

events.event: Police (Polri) report naming 245 people and 20 corporations suspects in forest and land fire (karhutla) cases, and Polda Kaltim names 33 suspects.
events.key_numbers: 245 individuals · 20 corporations · Polda Kaltim 33 suspects · BNPB: 462 ha still burning across 10 provinces (provincial rows sum to 434 ha)
events.why_it_matters: Whether companies, not just small farmers, face charges for the haze.

events.event: Government is due to finalise 2027 provincial minimum wages (UMP 2027); Menaker Yassierli says internal discussion should finish in November while unions demand 7.5-9.5% rises and hold rallies in 38 provinces through 30 Oct.
events.key_numbers: Union demand 7.5%-9.5% · internal deliberation target: end of November · formula follows new law (Menaker) · rallies 15-30 Oct in 38 provinces
events.why_it_matters: Decides what millions of workers' base pay will be in 2027.
